notes.title: Upcoming Release - Bouncemasters: Fly Pengu, Fly!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33026674/4bfc3b61bf987cdf7a2bad634ca50cc242bb7d1b.png[/img]
🔥 We have just announced Bouncemasters - fast, silly, and full of absurd physics-based fun game! All you do is launch a penguin with a bat of your choice - and try to fly as far as you can! And only one advice for you. Stay away from moose butt.

That is probably enough for the intro part - you still have something to do!

[h1]🎯 To Do List[/h1]
[b]✅ Watch the Trailer[/b]
https://youtu.be/l9cY8CrJx4M 
[b]✅ Wishlist the game[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3697340/Bouncemasters_Fly_Pengu_Fly/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=announcement
[b]⌛ Wait for Bouncemasters DEMO - Coming to Next Fest![/b]

[i]🤔 Anyone remembers Yetisports flash games back in the days? [/i]

notes.title: Global Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29002788/5dda415009018255e85fb132e4e0ec9fd51393f8.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29002788/7a79cbcbccf068e6c33c56542bbe611135fdafff.png[/img]


[b]Welcome to the newly updated Doodle God Blitz!
Dear players, after your numerous requests and offers we`ve added the following features: [/b]

- New activity reward system: for every day you play Doodle God Blitz, you`re getting rewarded with Coins you can spend on hints and additional content (DLC). You can earn Coins by participating in a tournament as well.

- New Daily Bonus system: collect your daily reward of hints and coins

- New "Survivor" DLC is available. Your objective is to create something to escape from the island in the middle of the ocean.

- Controller support - now it`s more comfortable to play.

Enjoy and thank you for your support! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/625430/Doodle_God_Blitz/
